Results.ReviewText: Bought our WEBER grill in 2019…… love it. Cooked on it a few times this year. Take good care of it..keep clean and covered…went out to pre heat …the igniter burner lit.the other 2 would not push in to light…when I called the first time I was sent knobs which I said I did not need…. Went to store where I purchased it and was told I need a manifold,which is the long part that the igniters and the knobs go onto…..GUESS WHAT?? It’s on back order!! Which to me means that this is a common problem!  Summer is winding down and now peaking and we cannot grill!,  I’m very disappointed..we bought Weber because ITS THE BEST!  Give me my old inexpensive grill any day….it lasted 10 years with NO problems!,,,
Results.Title: Disappointed in Ohio

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
